Writing is concise and original in structure, with useful concrete shrine and tree-study details. It avoids brochure praise, invented visits, service promises and unqualified chronology. Connected factual groups have appropriate native source notes.

Read Anvesha’s retained independent final source audit: it reproduces implementation allocations 143 district / 149 paper / 48 photograph, then strengthens them to 147 / 155 / 80 by charging all headings and metadata conservatively. All remain below 200. My separate claim and originality review found no extensive quotation or copied source paragraph.

Local verifier demands all 13 stage successes, fixed original hash, reviewed derivative hash, exact cross-edition article fragments, expected responsive 480/960/1280 widths, independently decoded 4:3 dimensions, native references and unique return targets, visible credits/share data, incoming cards, strict payload below 1 billion bytes and protected draft checks in both public editions.

Live verifier collects actual article and incoming-card image URLs, checks source/alt/text/credit and search policy, permits only recorded responsive URL substitutions, retains raw difference status and verifies content-addressed filenames. New public photo is compared to public derivative hash, not the distinct original hash.
Image comparison pins live/local file hashes, measures actual decoded differences and metadata, and never automatically accepts visual differences or infers an encoding cause.
